key_insight: LEAP learns a reusable, differentiable objective over complete trajectories, capturing local dynamics and dependencies across time.
engineering_relevance: A single learned action can support trajectory ranking, inference, mechanism steering, constrained optimization and sampling in scientific simulations.
method: Anchor the unknown stochastic action to a tractable reference process.
Learn an action correction by comparing observed trajectories with reference trajectories.
Reuse the resulting path-space objective across inference and control tasks.
evidence_signal: Evaluations span stochastic physical systems, many-body orbital dynamics and molecular simulations, reporting dynamics recovery, temporal dependency capture and transfer across objectives and physical conditions.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify accuracy or computational cost, leaving practical scaling and reference-process sensitivity to be assessed.
